title: Healthy habit of the day: Choose less ultra-processed food
excerpt: Packaged snacks and fast food are often high in sugar, salt and fat. Choosing more home-cooked meals and whole foods is a lasting habit.
content: Packaged snacks and fast food are often high in sugar, salt and fat. Choosing more home-cooked meals and whole foods is a lasting habit.
Swap one packaged snack a day for fruit, nuts or roasted chickpeas.
This is general information, not medical advice. Speak to a doctor or dietitian before changing your diet or exercise, especially if you have a health condition.
